completed_tasks.name: Find the real relay reservation ceiling
completed_tasks.evidence: The owner's sockets/memory hypothesis was DISPROVED by sweep: ulimit -n 1048576 against 632 descriptors, and RSS LOWER at 1024 peers than at 256. The real ceiling is connectionManager.maxConnections = 300, which this repo had never set, and which lives in libp2p/connection-manager/constants.js while its two documented siblings live in constants.defaults.js — which is why it went unnoticed. A relay tuned to maxReservations 1024 granted 305. It fails SILENTLY: excess peers report a successful start and hold no reservation.

decisions.rationale: Owner's call after seeing the sweep. 15 was libp2p's MAX_RESERVATION_STORE_SIZE and too low; 256 was offered and declined as more than needed.

decisions.decision: maxConnections DERIVES from maxReservations rather than being a second free-standing number
decisions.rationale: The two silently disagreeing is exactly how a relay tuned to 1024 came to serve 305. A derived default cannot drift out of step with the budget it is supposed to serve.

decisions.decision: The new e2e case asserts what was MEASURED (the refusal), not what was WANTED (the label)
decisions.rationale: Writing the hoped-for assertion would have produced a red test standing in for an owner decision. The measured assertion is a live guard on the actual state and turns red the day a chain IS wired — which is when it should be re-planned.
